cards.example: Sustainable policies balance economic growth with environmental protection.
cards.example_cn: 可持续政策要在经济增长与环保之间取得平衡。

cards.example: Governments can mitigate traffic congestion by investing in public transport.
cards.example_cn: 政府可通过投资公共交通来缓解拥堵。

cards.example: Free childcare would alleviate the financial burden on young families.
cards.example_cn: 免费托育能减轻年轻家庭的经济负担。

cards.example: Cutting funding for schools would exacerbate existing inequality.
cards.example_cn: 削减学校经费会加剧已有的不平等。

cards.example: Poor infrastructure limits economic development in rural areas.
cards.example_cn: 基础设施落后限制了农村的经济发展。

cards.example: The national curriculum should include practical financial literacy.
cards.example_cn: 国家课程应纳入实用的金融素养。

cards.example: Education is compulsory until the age of sixteen in many countries.
cards.example_cn: 许多国家教育义务制到十六岁。

cards.example: Vocational training offers a faster route into skilled employment.
cards.example_cn: 职业培训提供更快进入技术岗位的路径。

cards.example: Regular exercise improves cognitive performance in teenagers.
cards.example_cn: 规律运动能提升青少年的认知表现。

cards.example: Schools should nurture curiosity rather than simply reward memorisation.
cards.example_cn: 学校应培养好奇心，而非只奖励记忆。

cards.example: Tax incentives encourage companies to adopt cleaner technology.
cards.example_cn: 税收激励促使企业采用更清洁的技术。

cards.example: Many governments subsidise renewable energy to lower its cost.
cards.example_cn: 许多政府补贴可再生能源以降低成本。

cards.example: Funds should be allocated according to local need, not population size.
cards.example_cn: 资金应按地方需求而非人口规模分配。

cards.example: Collaborative projects enhance students' communication skills.
cards.example_cn: 合作项目能提升学生的沟通能力。

cards.example: Air quality has deteriorated sharply in fast-growing cities.
cards.example_cn: 快速发展的城市空气质量明显恶化。

cards.example: Moderate screen time can be beneficial for interactive learning.
cards.example_cn: 适度使用屏幕对互动学习有益。

cards.example: Excessive testing has a detrimental effect on young learners.
cards.example_cn: 过度考试对低龄学习者有害。

cards.example: Some job displacement is inevitable as automation spreads.
cards.example_cn: 随着自动化普及，部分岗位流失不可避免。

cards.example: Policymakers should prioritise preventive healthcare.
cards.example_cn: 政策制定者应优先发展预防性医疗。

cards.example: A complete ban is not feasible in the short term.
cards.example_cn: 短期内全面禁止并不可行。

cards.example: A coherent argument needs one clear position throughout.
cards.example_cn: 有说服力的论证需要贯穿全篇的明确立场。

cards.example: Concise sentences are usually clearer than long ones.
cards.example_cn: 简洁的句子通常比长句更清楚。

cards.example: The report offers compelling evidence for early intervention.
cards.example_cn: 该报告为早期干预提供了有力证据。

cards.example: The study used a rigorous methodology with a large sample.
cards.example_cn: 该研究采用了大样本的严谨方法。

cards.example: The difference between the two groups was negligible.
cards.example_cn: 两组之间的差异微乎其微。

cards.example: A substantial proportion of graduates work outside their field.
cards.example_cn: 相当比例的毕业生从事与本专业无关的工作。

cards.example: Cars remain the predominant form of transport in suburbs.
cards.example_cn: 在郊区，汽车仍是主要交通方式。

cards.example: Smartphone addiction is increasingly prevalent among teenagers.
cards.example_cn: 手机成瘾在青少年中日益普遍。

cards.example: Standardised testing remains a controversial policy.
cards.example_cn: 标准化考试仍是一项有争议的政策。

cards.example: Judges must remain impartial when assessing evidence.
cards.example_cn: 法官评估证据时必须保持公正。

cards.example: Consumers do not always make rational decisions.
cards.example_cn: 消费者并不总是做出理性决策。

cards.example: An arbitrary deadline can harm the quality of research.
cards.example_cn: 武断的期限会损害研究质量。

cards.example: Many educators advocate smaller class sizes.
cards.example_cn: 许多教育者主张缩小班级规模。

cards.example: Constant criticism undermines children's confidence.
cards.example_cn: 持续的批评会削弱孩子的自信。

cards.example: Repetition reinforces vocabulary retention.
cards.example_cn: 重复能强化词汇记忆。

cards.example: Online platforms facilitate collaboration across borders.
cards.example_cn: 在线平台促进了跨国协作。

cards.example: Poor internet access hinders rural students' learning.
cards.example_cn: 网络条件差会阻碍农村学生学习。

cards.example: The policy will be implemented in stages over five years.
cards.example_cn: 该政策将在五年内分阶段实施。

cards.example: Schools should integrate technology into everyday teaching.
cards.example_cn: 学校应把技术融入日常教学。

cards.example: Transparent hiring reduces the risk of discrimination.
cards.example_cn: 透明的招聘能降低歧视风险。

cards.example: Public accountability is essential for trust in institutions.
cards.example_cn: 公共问责是机构信任的基础。

cards.example: Community networks build resilience against natural disasters.
cards.example_cn: 社区网络能增强抵御自然灾害的韧性。

cards.example: Income inequality has widened over the past two decades.
cards.example_cn: 过去二十年收入不平等扩大了。

cards.example: There is a stark disparity in health outcomes between regions.
cards.example_cn: 各地区健康状况差距明显。

cards.example: Rapid urbanisation puts pressure on housing and transport.
cards.example_cn: 快速城市化给住房和交通带来压力。

cards.example: Congestion charges have reduced traffic in central London.
cards.example_cn: 拥堵费减少了伦敦市中心的交通量。

cards.example: Vehicle emissions are a major source of urban pollution.
cards.example_cn: 车辆排放是城市污染的主要来源。

cards.example: Renewable energy now accounts for a third of electricity supply.
cards.example_cn: 可再生能源目前占电力供应的三分之一。

cards.example: Wildlife conservation requires cooperation between countries.
cards.example_cn: 野生动物保护需要国家间合作。

cards.example: Deforestation threatens biodiversity in tropical regions.
cards.example_cn: 森林砍伐威胁热带地区的生物多样性。

cards.example: School meals shape children's long-term nutrition habits.
cards.example_cn: 学校餐食影响孩子的长期营养习惯。

cards.example: Childhood obesity has become a public health crisis.
cards.example_cn: 儿童肥胖已成为公共卫生危机。

cards.example: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
cards.example_cn: 久坐生活方式增加心脏病风险。

cards.example: The country struggled to contain the epidemic.
cards.example_cn: 该国难以控制这场流行病。

cards.example: Widespread vaccination reduced mortality dramatically.
cards.example_cn: 广泛接种大幅降低了死亡率。

cards.example: Early diagnosis significantly improves survival rates.
cards.example_cn: 早期诊断显著提高存活率。

cards.example: Companies struggle to recruit skilled engineers.
cards.example_cn: 企业难以招到熟练工程师。

cards.example: Flexible hours help employers retain experienced staff.
cards.example_cn: 弹性工时有助于雇主留住有经验的员工。

cards.example: Long working hours do not necessarily raise productivity.
cards.example_cn: 长时间工作未必提高生产率。

cards.example: Universities increasingly encourage entrepreneurship.
cards.example_cn: 大学越来越鼓励创业。

cards.example: Automation will reshape routine office work.
cards.example_cn: 自动化将重塑常规办公工作。

cards.example: The factory announced hundreds of redundancies.
cards.example_cn: 该工厂宣布裁员数百人。

cards.example: Long commutes reduce time available for family life.
cards.example_cn: 长通勤减少了家庭生活时间。

cards.example: The city lacks affordable housing for young workers.
cards.example_cn: 该城市缺少年轻工薪族能负担的住房。

cards.example: The welfare system supports those unable to work.
cards.example_cn: 福利制度支持无法工作的人。

cards.example: New legislation restricts single-use plastics.
cards.example_cn: 新立法限制一次性塑料。

cards.example: Stricter regulation is needed for data privacy.
cards.example_cn: 数据隐私需要更严格的监管。

cards.example: Heavy penalties deter illegal waste dumping.
cards.example_cn: 重罚能遏制非法倾倒垃圾。

cards.example: Digital literacy is now as important as reading.
cards.example_cn: 数字素养如今与阅读能力同样重要。

cards.example: Language proficiency develops through regular use.
cards.example_cn: 语言熟练度通过经常使用而提升。

cards.example: Learners who immerse themselves in English improve faster.
cards.example_cn: 沉浸式学习英语的人进步更快。

cards.example: Intrinsic motivation predicts long-term achievement better than rewards.
cards.example_cn: 内在动机比奖励更能预测长期成就。

cards.example: Green spaces contribute to residents' wellbeing.
cards.example_cn: 绿地有助于居民的身心健康。

cards.example: Excessive workload is a leading cause of teacher burnout.
cards.example_cn: 过重的工作量是教师倦怠的主要原因。

cards.example: Cross-disciplinary collaboration drives innovation.
cards.example_cn: 跨学科协作推动创新。

cards.example: Transparency in pricing protects consumers.
cards.example_cn: 定价透明能保护消费者。

cards.example: Resilient economies recover faster from shocks.
cards.example_cn: 有韧性的经济体从冲击中恢复更快。

cards.example: Rural schools often lack resources available to their urban counterparts.
cards.example_cn: 农村学校常缺乏城市同类学校拥有的资源。

cards.back: 支持……的有力论点；写论证段开头用
cards.example: There is a compelling argument for investing in early education.
cards.example_cn: 有充分理由投资早期教育。

cards.example: To a large extent, success depends on consistent practice.
cards.example_cn: 成功在很大程度上取决于持续练习。

cards.example: In the long run, prevention is cheaper than treatment.
cards.example_cn: 长远看，预防比治疗更省钱。

cards.example: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping children's habits.
cards.example_cn: 父母在塑造孩子习惯中起关键作用。

cards.example: Schools place too much emphasis on exam results.
cards.example_cn: 学校过于重视考试结果。

cards.example: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine life.
cards.example_cn: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物构成严重威胁。

cards.example: Excessive noise has a detrimental effect on sleep quality.
cards.example_cn: 过度噪音对睡眠质量有不良影响。

cards.example: Policies should take into account the needs of older residents.
cards.example_cn: 政策应考虑到老年居民的需求。

cards.example: We should draw a distinction between equality and uniformity.
cards.example_cn: 我们应区分平等与一律。

cards.example: In stark contrast, rural areas still lack basic clinics.
cards.example_cn: 相比之下，农村地区仍缺乏基础诊所。

cards.example: A growing body of evidence links diet to mental health.
cards.example_cn: 越来越多证据表明饮食与心理健康相关。

cards.example: Rehabilitation addresses the root cause of reoffending.
cards.example_cn: 改造措施解决再犯的根本原因。

cards.example: Cities must strike a balance between growth and liveability.
cards.example_cn: 城市须在发展与宜居间取得平衡。

cards.example: The economy is underpinned by a skilled workforce.
cards.example_cn: 经济以熟练劳动力为基础。

cards.example: Economic growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
cards.example_cn: 经济增长不应以环境为代价。

cards.example: Cheap broadband paved the way for remote work.
cards.example_cn: 廉价宽带为远程办公铺平道路。

cards.example: The survey sheds light on why students drop out.
cards.example_cn: 该调查揭示了学生辍学的原因。

cards.example: In light of recent data, the policy should be revised.
cards.example_cn: 鉴于最新数据，政策应作调整。

cards.example: Quiet study spaces are conducive to concentration.
cards.example_cn: 安静的学习空间有助于专注。

cards.example: Rapid growth has given rise to housing shortages.
cards.example_cn: 快速增长导致了住房短缺。

cards.example: Tourism expanded at the expense of local culture.
cards.example_cn: 旅游业扩张以牺牲本地文化为代价。

cards.example: This is arguably the most effective short-term measure.
cards.example_cn: 这可以说是最有效的短期措施。

cards.example: It is widely acknowledged that early intervention works.
cards.example_cn: 人们普遍认为早期干预有效。

cards.front: there is a growing consensus that
cards.example: There is a growing consensus that testing alone is insufficient.
cards.example_cn: 越来越多人认为仅靠考试不够。

cards.example: While it is true that costs rise, the benefits outweigh them.
cards.example_cn: 尽管成本上升属实，收益仍大于成本。

cards.front: this is particularly the case for
cards.example: This is particularly the case for low-income families.
cards.example_cn: 对低收入家庭尤其如此。

cards.example: Singapore's transport system is a case in point.
cards.example_cn: 新加坡的交通系统就是一例。

cards.example: Better teacher training would go a long way towards improving results.
cards.example_cn: 更好的教师培训大大有助于提高成绩。

cards.example: Volunteers make a significant contribution to community care.
cards.example_cn: 志愿者对社区照护贡献显著。

cards.example: All proposals are subject to independent review.
cards.example_cn: 所有提案都要接受独立审查。

cards.example: In the face of rising costs, families cut spending.
cards.example_cn: 面对成本上升，家庭削减开支。

cards.example: With regard to funding, the budget remains unclear.
cards.example_cn: 关于资金，预算仍不明确。

cards.example: From an economic perspective, prevention saves money.
cards.example_cn: 从经济角度看，预防更省钱。

cards.example: The extent to which technology helps depends on how it is used.
cards.example_cn: 技术帮助多大取决于如何使用。

cards.example: The issue is not merely economic but also social.
cards.example_cn: 这个问题不仅是经济问题，也是社会问题。

cards.example: Far from being a luxury, internet access is now a necessity.
cards.example_cn: 网络接入远非奢侈，如今已是必需品。

cards.example: Skills matter more than credentials, as opposed to what many assume.
cards.example_cn: 与很多人以为的不同，技能比文凭更重要。

cards.example: By and large, the policy has achieved its aims.
cards.example_cn: 总的来说，该政策已实现目标。

cards.example: On balance, the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.
cards.example_cn: 权衡下来，利大于弊。

cards.example: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
cards.example_cn: 值得注意的是，结果因地区而异。

cards.back: Free university education widens access for students from low-income families and raises national skill levels.
cards.example: Countries such as Germany abolished tuition fees while maintaining strong enrolment.
cards.example_cn: 德国等国取消学费的同时保持了较高入学率。

cards.front: 教育·考试能否衡量能力
cards.back: Standardised tests measure a narrow range of skills and often reward memorisation over critical thinking.
cards.example: Many employers report graduates with high scores but weak problem-solving.
cards.example_cn: 许多雇主反映毕业生分数高但解决问题能力弱。

cards.back: Vocational education gives students a faster, cheaper route into stable employment.
cards.example: Apprenticeship schemes in Switzerland produce low youth unemployment.
cards.example_cn: 瑞士学徒制带来较低的青年失业率。

cards.back: Technology can personalise learning, but only when teachers are trained to use it.
cards.example: Schools that supplied devices without training saw little improvement.
cards.example_cn: 只发设备不做培训的学校成效甚微。

cards.back: Homework reinforces classroom learning but excessive amounts harm family time and wellbeing.
cards.example: Some countries cap homework at thirty minutes per night.
cards.example_cn: 一些国家把作业上限定为每晚三十分钟。

cards.front: 环境·个人还是政府负责
cards.back: Individual action matters, yet systemic change requires government regulation.
cards.example: Recycling campaigns succeed only where collection infrastructure exists.
cards.example_cn: 回收运动只有在收集设施到位时才有效。

cards.back: Growth and environmental protection are not mutually exclusive when clean technology is subsidised.
cards.example: Renewable investment created jobs while cutting emissions.
cards.example_cn: 可再生能源投资在减排放的同时创造了就业。

cards.back: Bans on single-use plastics reduce waste only if affordable alternatives exist.
cards.example: Ireland's plastic bag levy cut usage by over ninety percent.
cards.example_cn: 爱尔兰塑料袋税使使用量下降九成以上。

cards.back: Urban green spaces improve air quality and residents' mental health.
cards.example: Studies link park access to lower stress levels.
cards.example_cn: 研究把公园可达性与较低压力水平联系起来。

cards.back: Richer nations bear greater historical responsibility for emissions and should fund adaptation elsewhere.
cards.example: Per-capita emissions in developed countries remain far higher.
cards.example_cn: 发达国家人均排放仍远高于其他地区。

cards.back: Automation displaces routine jobs but creates demand for new technical roles.
cards.example: Bank teller numbers fell while data analyst roles expanded.
cards.example_cn: 银行柜员减少而数据分析岗位增加。

cards.back: Social media connects people but can amplify anxiety and misinformation.
cards.example: Teen mental health indicators declined alongside smartphone adoption.
cards.example_cn: 青少年心理健康指标随智能手机普及而下降。

cards.back: Convenience often requires personal data, so regulation must set clear limits.
cards.example: Data protection laws force companies to justify collection.
cards.example_cn: 数据保护法迫使企业说明收集理由。

cards.back: Remote work broadens opportunities but can weaken team cohesion.
cards.example: Hybrid models retain flexibility while preserving collaboration.
cards.example_cn: 混合办公在保留灵活性的同时维持协作。

cards.back: Unequal access to devices and broadband deepens educational inequality.
cards.example: Rural students were most affected during school closures.
cards.example_cn: 停课期间农村学生受影响最大。

cards.back: Preventive spending reduces long-term costs more than treating advanced illness.
cards.example: Vaccination programmes are consistently cost-effective.
cards.example_cn: 疫苗项目始终具有成本效益。

cards.back: Taxes on sugary drinks reduce consumption, especially among low-income groups.
cards.example: Mexico's sugar tax lowered purchases of sweetened drinks.
cards.example_cn: 墨西哥糖税降低了含糖饮料购买量。

cards.back: Regular physical activity improves mood and academic performance.
cards.example: Schools with daily PE report better concentration.
cards.example_cn: 每天安排体育课的学校报告专注力更好。

cards.back: Ageing populations require more care workers and pension reform.
cards.example: Japan raised the retirement age to sustain pensions.
cards.example_cn: 日本提高退休年龄以维持养老金。

cards.back: Late-night screen use disrupts sleep and harms concentration.
cards.example: Sleep studies show delayed melatonin release after blue light exposure.
cards.example_cn: 睡眠研究显示蓝光暴露延迟褪黑素分泌。

cards.back: A shorter week can raise productivity by reducing burnout.
cards.example: Trials in Iceland reported maintained output with better wellbeing.
cards.example_cn: 冰岛试验报告产出不变而幸福感提升。

cards.back: Universities should teach transferable skills rather than narrow job training.
cards.example: Employers value communication and analysis over specific tools.
cards.example_cn: 雇主更看重沟通与分析能力而非特定工具。

cards.back: Frequent job changes can accelerate skill growth but may limit deep expertise.
cards.example: Early-career mobility often raises salaries.
cards.example_cn: 职业早期流动通常提高薪资。

cards.back: Productivity under remote work depends on task type and management quality.
cards.example: Routine tasks suffered while focused work improved.
cards.example_cn: 常规任务受影响，需要专注的工作反而提升。

cards.back: Internships bridge the gap between academic study and workplace expectations.
cards.example: Graduates with internships find work faster.
cards.example_cn: 有实习经历的毕业生更快找到工作。

cards.back: Investing in public transport reduces congestion more efficiently than building roads.
cards.example: Road expansion often induces additional traffic.
cards.example_cn: 扩建道路往往诱发更多交通量。

cards.back: Housing costs push young workers away from opportunity-rich cities.
cards.example: Rent controls can help tenants but reduce new supply.
cards.example_cn: 租金管制有助租户但抑制新增供给。

cards.back: Urbanisation concentrates opportunity but strains infrastructure.
cards.example: Rapid growth outpaces water and waste systems.
cards.example_cn: 快速增长超出供水和垃圾处理能力。

cards.back: Walkable neighbourhoods improve health and local business.
cards.example: Pedestrianised centres report higher retail turnover.
cards.example_cn: 步行化中心区零售额更高。

cards.back: Preserving historic districts supports tourism and local identity.
cards.example: Heritage-led regeneration attracts visitors year-round.
cards.example_cn: 以遗产为导向的更新全年吸引游客。

cards.back: everyone studies（everyone 作主语是单数，动词加 s。）
cards.example: Everyone studies differently.
cards.example_cn: 每个人学习方式不同。

cards.back: university is to prepare（be for 后接名词/动名词，表目的用 be to do。）
cards.example: University is to prepare students for work.
cards.example_cn: 大学是为了让学生为工作做准备。

cards.back: more motivated（系动词后要用形容词。）
cards.example: Students become more motivated when they choose topics.
cards.example_cn: 学生自主选题时更有动力。

cards.back: discuss（discuss 是及物动词，不加 about。）
cards.example: We will discuss the issue tomorrow.
cards.example_cn: 我们明天讨论这个问题。

cards.back: in my opinion（according to 只用于引用他人或数据。）
cards.example: In my opinion, the benefits outweigh the costs.
cards.example_cn: 我认为利大于弊。

cards.example: Society benefits from better education.
cards.example_cn: 社会受益于更好的教育。

cards.example: The information was useful.
cards.example_cn: 这些信息很有用。

cards.back: research shows（research 作不可数名词。）
cards.example: Research shows that sleep affects memory.
cards.example_cn: 研究表明睡眠影响记忆。

cards.back: economic development is beneficial（be 后接形容词。）
cards.example: Development is beneficial to rural areas.
cards.example_cn: 发展对农村地区有益。

cards.back: people who are（people 是复数，关系从句动词随主语变化。）
cards.example: People who are motivated learn faster.
cards.example_cn: 有动力的人学得更快。

cards.example: Nowadays most students use laptops.
cards.example_cn: 如今大多数学生使用笔记本电脑。

cards.back: as we all know,（as we all know 后直接接逗号，不接 that。）
cards.example: As we all know, practice matters.
cards.example_cn: 众所周知，练习很重要。

cards.back: extremely important（very much 不修饰形容词。）
cards.example: Sleep is extremely important for teenagers.
cards.example_cn: 睡眠对青少年极其重要。

cards.back: cannot（正式写作中写成一个词。）
cards.example: We cannot ignore climate change.
cards.example_cn: 我们不能忽视气候变化。

cards.front: one of the most important thing
cards.back: one of the most important things（one of 后接复数名词。）
cards.example: Exercise is one of the most important habits.
cards.example_cn: 运动是最重要的习惯之一。

cards.back: the number of people is（the number of 作主语视为单数。）
cards.example: The number of applicants is rising.
cards.example_cn: 申请人数在上升。

cards.front: I think that is depend on
cards.back: I think it depends on（depend 需要主语，用 it depends on。）
cards.example: It depends on individual circumstances.
cards.example_cn: 这取决于个人情况。

cards.back: make progress（progress 不可数，不加 a。）
cards.example: Students make progress through feedback.
cards.example_cn: 学生通过反馈取得进步。

cards.back: make a decision（decision 与 make 搭配。）
cards.example: Governments must make a decision quickly.
cards.example_cn: 政府必须迅速作出决定。

cards.front: afford to buy a house for young people is hard
cards.back: it is hard for young people to afford a house（避免过长主语，用 it 作形式主语。）
cards.example: It is hard for graduates to afford housing.
cards.example_cn: 毕业生很难负担住房。
